newsitem.title: CAMEROON: Cameroon puts Meridien BIAO bank in liquidation.
newsitem.headline: Cameroon puts Meridien BIAO bank in liquidation.

text.p: The Cameroon government said it had placed Banque Meridien BIAO Cameroon in liquidation after failing to find a buyer following the collapse of parent company, Meridien International Bank Ltd (MBIL).
Attempts to restructure the Cameroon unit have proved unsuccessful since MBIL was placed in liquidation in May 1995.
The Cameroon bank belonged to the Meridien network in Africa owned by Luxembourg-based Meridien BIAO SA, which in turn was majority-owned by MBIL.

The liquidation of Meridien BIAO Cameroon, announced in a government statement on Monday, dealt a new blow to Cameroon's struggling banking sector. Meridien was one of the largest banks with deposits of 110 billion CFA francs.
